input.body:
Overall a good month. Onboarding was smooth, the import tool saved us a lot of manual work, and support has been responsive. A few wishes: bulk edit on the boards view, a Slack integration that posts on status change, and keyboard navigation in the picker. I know these are all nice-to-haves.

One thing I should mention: deleting a single project deleted every project in the workspace for us on Friday. We restored from our own backup so we are fine, but we have not touched Delete since.
input.subject: Feedback after our first month
